items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I come back to pick up my drums with Jimmy Jewell that - where you played all the dances at the Dreamland Ballroom

ctx.x: You joined them in Kansas City - were you there when Fletcher was there?
I didn't join them. I come back to pick up my drums with Jimmy Jewell that - where you played all the dances at the Dreamland Ballroom and they told me, you can't leave. Ben Webster and
all of them stopped you from going, so you stayed, huh?
